# PNEUMA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 4
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic/Functional)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 7 (partial) | Coptic
**Chapter:** 4

---

[Pages 1-6 are lost. The manuscript survives again at page 7, mid-conversation.]

**4:1** [...]"So will matter be destroyed in the end, or won't it?"

**4:2** The Savior answered, "Every kind of nature, every form, every created thing — they all exist in and through each other, and in the end they will each return to their own origin.

**4:3** "The nature of matter returns to the root from which matter itself came.

**4:4** "Anyone with ears — listen."

---

*Translator's Note (PNEUMA):* PNEUMA renders the cosmic-philosophical framing accessibly without softening its ontological force. The ear-saying is kept terse.
